title: Beware of Words: Evaluating the Lexical Diversity of Conversational LLMs using ChatGPT as Case Study

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM to adopt personas of different ages (e.g., 5-year-old child, young adult, elderly adult) and comparing the lexical diversity metrics (MATTR, MTLD, RTTR, Maas) of the generated texts to see if the model unfairly alters its vocabulary richness based on age.

Assigning male and female personas across various age and socioeconomic groups (e.g., young adult male vs. young adult female) and analyzing the generated outputs to measure if there are significant differences in lexical diversity based on the gender of the assigned role.

Prompting the model to generate text from the perspective of different social classes (e.g., affluent adult versus lower-class adult) and calculating lexical diversity metrics to detect whether the model associates lower vocabulary richness with lower socioeconomic status.
